name: Live extraction — two-line invoice, deterministic layer only
why:
The one extraction path with real traffic, frozen at its deterministic layer.

RISKS.md N2 is fixed and pinned here: this invoice says 'Country of origin: TR' and origin_country used to come back null, because the regex matched only the phrase 'origin country'. Origin country decides CBAM scope and the electricity factor, so a null there is not cosmetic.

One goods line is extracted from a two-line invoice, and that is correct for THIS case rather than a defect: the golden adapter runs with no API key, so the deterministic layer runs alone and the second line is what the Claude pass would supply. The RISKS.md N1 defect — Claude's lines being discarded whenever the deterministic layer found any line at all — is fixed, and covered by api/tests/ledger/test_line_merge_and_origin.py, which can exercise the merge with a fixed Claude payload. It cannot be frozen here, because a live model call is not reproducible.
